description: Use for attack-surface mapping, asset inventory or competitive research: lists every hostname under a domain that appears in unexpired publicly-logged TLS certificates, deduplicated, with wildcard flag, first-seen date, latest certificate expiry and issuer. Data from crt.sh (Sectigo) with Cert Spotter (SSLMate) as fallback; the response names the source. Only names in public certificates, no DNS brute force. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.003 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
name: subdomains
title: ScrapeMole Domains: DNS, WHOIS/RDAP, domain availability, email security, SSL certificates and subdomains for AI agents: Subdomains from Certificate Transparency
